name: A Reproducible Webots-Based Benchmarking Framework for UAV Mobility Modeling
description: This archive accompanies the article "A Reproducible Webots-Based Benchmarking Framework for UAV Mobility Modeling: Comparative Evaluation of Random Waypoint and Gauss-Markov Trajectories in Urban and Open-Terrain Environments" (Journal of Engineering, University of Baghdad). It contains everything needed to recompute every table and figure of the article from the recorded runs and to re-run any single simulation:- the Webots R2025a worlds (Open Terrain, and Urban with 50 buildings), with the building layout file;- the Python controller, which uses a cascaded PID flight controller with noisy GPS and gyro;- the Random Waypoint and Gauss–Markov reference generators;- the batch runner;- the analysis code (metrics, air-to-ground channel model, paired statistics with Holm correction) and its unit tests;- the 10 Hz logs and metadata of all 450 runs: 120 main runs (2 environments × 2 mobility models × 30 seeds), 210 runs of a memory-coefficient (α) sweep, and 120 ablation runs.A SHA-256 manifest lists every file. See README.md for the folder structure and for how to reproduce the results.
